checkpoint.title: Out of Saffron Gym by Escape Rope, Fly to Saffron's Center and heal

events.why: out of Saffron Gym from Sabrina's room, as 16.06 out of Silph Co.: SaffronCity_Gym allows it (pokefirered map.json: allow_escaping true), and the rope takes the player to the escape warp, set when 16.06b walked north into the gym's door (46, 12) from Saffron (overworld.c UpdateEscapeWarp(): the tile below the door, (46, 13)). The bag has 3 by now: 4 at 16.06, less its rope
the Pidgey flies to Saffron City, landing below the Pokemon Center's door (24, 38) on its heal spot (pokefirered heal_locations.json, HEAL_LOCATION_SAFFRON_CITY), as 18.03
turn to face the Center's door (24, 38) from the landing
the Center script in: through the door and up to the nurse; no map of the Center

checkpoint: Starts in front of Sabrina, where 18.02 ends after her battle and saves.

Out by Escape Rope and Fly, not back by the four pads and the gym's door: that walk was about 40 tiles over four pads (user, 2026-11-15: every Center trip flies once Fly is learned, and a building that allows an Escape Rope is left by rope). Before that, the walk round the city's blocks to the Center was about 80 tiles for a straight line of 48 (console B, 2026-11-15).
Ends at Saffron's nurse, facing her: 18.03's start.
Starts with silph_cleared, as 16.06b: Silph Co.'s Giovanni (16.05) sent the Rockets out of Saffron City, so the rope's landing (46, 13), where one of them stood, is free.
